name: TAMU Competency Assessment Tool
description: Temporary Heroku app for PR previews of TAMU Competency Assessment Tool.

RAILS_MASTER_KEY.description: Copy from config/master.key so Rails can boot in production mode.

EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED.description: Leave outbound email disabled for new/review apps until APP_HOST and SMTP settings are confirmed.

APP_HOST.description: Canonical host for generated email links; required when EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED=true unless Heroku review-app metadata supplies the app hostname.
